measurement_notes.first_node_details_ms: Legacy metric: elapsed from navigation start through the first node details becoming visible.
measurement_notes.click_to_details_ms: Elapsed from clicking node 1 until its details become visible.
measurement_notes.sse_updates.long_tasks: Legacy full-page long-task durations collected by the shared setup observer.
measurement_notes.sse_updates.long_tasks_update: Long-task entries whose startTime falls within the 120-update measurement window.
measurement_notes.cpu_vs_raf: TaskDuration and ScriptDuration are browser CPU time deltas; update times and drag frame_times_ms are elapsed/frame timings and are not CPU time.
measurement_notes.drag.transform: Computed viewport transform before the drag, at the intermediate point, and after returning to the start.
